stem: Which statement describes one of Mrs. Baird's business challenges?

options.label: F
options.text: She had trouble teaching her children how to help with the business.

options.label: G
options.text: She needed to find new ways to deliver her baked goods as sales increased.

options.label: H
options.text: She was not able to remember the type of baked goods her customers ordered.

options.label: J
options.text: She was not able to make enough money to purchase supplies.
